mentions.name: Basilform
mentions.description: A form backend service: users point an HTML form to a generated URL and can start accepting submissions without writing backend code or managing infrastructure.
mentions.problem: Accepting website form submissions normally requires backend code and infrastructure; this removes that need.
mentions.source_excerpt: Im working on a form backend app - fun little project I'm building on the side. It's pretty simple and self-explanatory - you point your HTML form to a url the app gives you and you can start accepting submissions without having to worry about backend code/infra.
